# Singapore International Water Week (SIWW)

> > Singapore International Water Week is a global platform for water innovation, sustainability, and technology solutions addressing urban water challenges.

SIWW is an annual international event and expo held in Singapore that brings together water professionals, innovators, and policymakers to showcase cutting-edge water technologies and solutions. The platform features the prestigious Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize recognizing groundbreaking contributions to global water management.

## Key Topics

- Singapore International Water Week
- Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize
- Water Expo
- Water Innovation
- Wastewater Treatment
- Water Sustainability
- Flood Management
- Water Technology
- Water Convention
- Membrane Bioreactor
- Water Reuse
- River Basin Management
- Water Microbiology
- Anaerobic Treatment
- Southeast Asia

## Main Events & Conferences

- [SIWW Official](https://www.siww.com.sg): Singapore International Water Week homepage showcasing global water innovation platform
- [SIWW Event](https://www.siww.com.sg/home): Singapore International Water Week 2022 event overview and registration
- [Water Expo](https://www.siww.com.sg/water-expo): SIWW Water Expo trade show featuring water technology and sustainable solutions
- [Spotlight 2025](https://www.siww.com.sg/spotlight-2025): SIWW Spotlight 2025: flood resilient cities conference at Singapore EXPO

## Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize Laureates

- [Professor Gertjan Medema](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-gertjan-medema): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: wastewater epidemiology innovator
- [Professor Kazuo Yamamoto](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-kazuo-yamamoto): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: membrane bioreactor technology pioneer
- [Professor Rita Colwell](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-rita-colwell): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: water microbiology and disease prevention
- [Professor John Cherry](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-john-cherry): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: groundwater science and hydrogeology expert
- [Professor Mark van Loosdrecht](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-mark-van-loosdrecht): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: Anammox wastewater treatment innovator
- [Dr James Barnard](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/dr-james-barnard): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: biological nutrient removal pioneer
- [Professor Gatze Lettinga](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/professor-gatze-lettinga): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: anaerobic wastewater treatment innovator
- [Dr Andrew Benedek](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/dr-andrew-benedek): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize laureate: membrane technology and water treatment

## Prize Recipients & Organizations

- [Orange County Water District](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/orange-county-water-district): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize recipient: water reuse and groundwater management
- [Yellow River Conservancy Commission](https://www.siww.com.sg/landing-page/lee-kuan-yew-water-prize-laureates/yellow-river-conservancy-commission): Lee Kuan Yew Water Prize recipient: integrated river basin management expert
